svg.text: One basket, two routes: 41% less time to prepare it
14 items on a 60x40 store. Dark blocks are shelves, yellow dots are the items, the blue square is the packing station.
Both runs use the same walking speed and pick time, and play at the same pace: the shorter route finishes first.
482 s to prepare the basket, 518 m walked
